# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a course's section when the course first draws with its
# shaders, so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's
# docs/porting.md, Prebuilt shader lists).
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section. Section 0 is the
# launcher, the boot (the logos and the title) and the main menu, reached with Start as a player does. Then a section a
# course, the 24 of the Jack, Queen, King and Joker cups: GP Race from the main menu with A, through machine select and
# the machine's settings, the course set at machine select where the race reads it (gCourseIndex, 0x800F8514), then 40 s
# of the game's time with the computer driving player 1's machine (RACER_STATE_CPU_CONTROLLED in gRacers[0]'s flags,
# 0x802C4924), and the pause menu. Not recorded: the X cup's courses, which the game makes up each time from the same
# venues, Death Race, Time Attack, VS, the results, records and options screens, and the course editor. Flags follow
# settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
